about.bio1: Kosovar Albanian Syrian scholar and retired professor of Middle East studies. Born in Damascus to a Kosovo Albanian family — father from Peja, mother from Vrella e Istogu — he studied Arabic language and literature at Damascus University, then earned three doctorates at Pristina University: in Albanian history (1977), philological sciences (1981), and historical sciences (1986).
about.bio2: He taught Arabic at Pristina's Faculty of Philology from 1975 until expelled by the Milošević regime in 1987. He subsequently taught at Yarmouk University in Irbid and Al al-Bayt University in Mafraq, Jordan, until retirement in 2018. He directed the House of Wisdom Institute, collaborated on the Great Arab Encyclopaedia in Damascus, and served as a member of both the Syrian Arab Academy of Sciences and the Academy of Sciences and Arts of Kosovo (ASHAK). In the Arab world he is regarded as the foremost expert on Islam in the Balkans.
